author.description: Only keep posts written by this handle (with or without @).
author.title: Posted by handle

authorHandles.description: Used by the 'Posts by author' mode. Accepts @handle, handle, or https://x.com/handle profile URLs.
authorHandles.title: Author handles or profile URLs

conversationId.description: Used by the 'Conversation thread' mode. Paste the root post ID or a post URL in that thread.
conversationId.title: Conversation ID or post URL

dateFrom.description: Only keep posts published on or after this date (UTC).
dateFrom.title: Start date

dateTo.description: Only keep posts published on or before this date (UTC).
dateTo.title: End date

excludeReplies.description: Drop replies and keep top-level posts only.
excludeReplies.title: Exclude replies

excludeRetweets.description: Drop reposts and keep original posts only.
excludeRetweets.title: Exclude reposts

inReplyTo.description: Only keep posts that are replies to this handle (with or without @).
inReplyTo.title: Replying to handle

keywords.description: Words, phrases or hashtags to search for. Each keyword is collected separately and every row shows the keyword that found it (searchTerm).
keywords.title: Keywords or phrases

language.description: Only keep posts in this language. The default searches every language.
language.title: Language

maxItems.description: Stop after this many posts per keyword or author. The URL and conversation modes use it as a total cap.
maxItems.title: Maximum posts

mentioning.description: Only keep posts that mention this handle (with or without @). Applied after collection.
mentioning.sectionDescription: These are applied to collected posts, never sent as opaque search operators.
mentioning.title: Mentioning handle

minimumLikes.description: Drop posts below this like count. Posts whose count is unavailable are dropped and reported in the run summary.
minimumLikes.title: Minimum likes

minimumReplies.description: Drop posts below this reply count. Posts with no available reply count are dropped and reported.
minimumReplies.title: Minimum replies

minimumRetweets.description: Drop posts below this repost count. Counts are filled from the public fallback source when available.
minimumRetweets.title: Minimum reposts

mode.description: Search by keyword, collect an author's posts, fetch specific post URLs, or open a conversation thread.
mode.sectionDescription: Choose one mode, then fill the target field that belongs to it.
mode.title: What do you want to collect?

onlyImages.description: Keep posts that contain at least one photo.
onlyImages.title: Posts with images only

onlyQuotes.description: Keep posts that quote another post.
onlyQuotes.title: Quote posts only

onlyVerifiedUsers.description: Keep posts from verified or blue-check accounts only.
onlyVerifiedUsers.title: Verified accounts only

onlyVideos.description: Keep posts that contain at least one video or GIF.
onlyVideos.title: Posts with videos only

postUrls.description: Used by the 'Specific post URLs' mode. Accepts x.com or twitter.com post links and bare post IDs.
postUrls.title: Post URLs or IDs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. No proxy is needed. If supplied, it is used for the best-effort guest search supplement as well as page requests.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Optional settings for special network environments.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

sort.description: Latest is newest first. Top is ordered by likes and reposts. Top + Latest returns the top half by engagement, then the newest remaining posts.
sort.title: Result order

title: X Keyword Search with Mention & Reply Operators
